items.stem: What do we know about the woman before she went to Europe?

choices.text: She listened to recordings of many European orchestras.
choices.zh: 她听过许多欧洲管弦乐团的录音。

choices.text: She read a lot about European musicians and their music.
choices.zh: 她阅读了大量关于欧洲音乐家及其音乐的资料。

choices.text: She dreamed of working and living in a European country.
choices.zh: 她梦想在欧洲国家工作和生活。

choices.text: She learned playing the violin from a famous French musician.
choices.zh: 她跟一位法国著名音乐家学习拉小提琴。

items.stem: What does the woman say about her music experience?

choices.text: She was a pupil of a famous European violinist.
choices.zh: 她曾是一位欧洲著名小提琴家的学生。

choices.text: She gave her first performance with her father.
choices.zh: 她与父亲一起进行了首次演出。

choices.text: She became a professional violinist at fifteen.
choices.zh: 她在十五岁时成为了职业小提琴家。

choices.text: She began taking violin lessons as a small child.
choices.zh: 她从很小的时候就开始上小提琴课。

items.stem: When did the woman go to Europe for the first time?
What does the woman say about her study in Paris?

choices.text: It was the chance of a lifetime.
choices.zh: 这是一生中难得的机会。

choices.text: It was a great challenge to her.
choices.zh: 这对她来说是一个巨大的挑战。

choices.text: It gave her a chance to explore the city.
choices.zh: 这给了她探索这座城市的机会。

choices.text: It helped her learn classical French music.
choices.zh: 这帮助她学习了古典法国音乐。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about William Shakespeare?

choices.text: There are mysterious stories behind his works.
choices.zh: 他的作品背后有神秘的故事。

choices.text: His personal history is little known.
choices.zh: 他的个人历史鲜为人知。

choices.text: His works have no match worldwide.
choices.zh: 他的作品在世界范围内无与伦比。

choices.text: There are many misunderstandings about him.

items.stem: What do we learn about Shakespeare's father?

choices.text: He once worked in a well-known acting company.
choices.zh: 他曾在一家知名的剧团工作过。

choices.text: He moved to Stratford-on-Avon in his childhood.
choices.zh: 他童年时搬到了埃文河畔斯特拉特福。

choices.text: He failed to go beyond grammar school.
choices.zh: 他没能完成文法学校之后的学业。

choices.text: He was a member of the town council.

items.stem: Why does the speaker say parts of Shakespeare's life will remain a mystery?

choices.text: People of his time had little interest in him.
choices.zh: 他那个时代的人对他兴趣不大。

choices.text: His works were adapted beyond recognition.
choices.zh: 他的作品被改编得面目全非。

choices.text: Possible sources of clues about him were lost in a fire.
choices.zh: 关于他的可能线索来源在一场火灾中丢失了。

choices.text: Writers of his time had no means to protect their works.
choices.zh: 他那个时代的作家没有办法保护自己的作品。

items.stem: How did people feel when they learned of Gerald Ratner's remarks?
What does the story of Gerald Ratner suggest?

choices.text: He is not laughed at, that laughs at himself first.
choices.zh: 先自嘲者不会被人嘲笑。

choices.text: There should be a limit to one's sense of humour.
choices.zh: 一个人的幽默感应该有限度。

choices.text: He who never learns from the past is bound to fail.
choices.zh: 从不吸取过去教训的人注定会失败。

choices.text: The words of some businesspeople are just rubbish.
choices.zh: 某些商界人士的话只是垃圾。
